Name: Soundboard
Author: Atacama Blooms
Description: Plays a sound file per key through Voicemeeter Banana/Potato – on your headphones and on your microphone, so meeting participants hear it too.

Actions.Name: Play Sound
Actions.Tooltip: Plays a sound file on your headphones and your microphone (via Voicemeeter). Replaces a sound that is already playing.

Actions.Name: Stop Sound
Actions.Tooltip: Stops the sound that is currently playing.
